title: 19-B Soup
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Kali mirch powder (Black pepper powder) 2 tsp
Namak (Salt) ¼ tsp or to taste
Water ¼ Cup or as required
Hara pyaz (Green onion) leaves ½ Cup

steps.instruction: In a pot,add cooking oil,ginger and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Pot mein cooking oil aur adrak dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken and mix well until changes color.
steps.romanUrdu: Chicken dal ker rang tabdeel hunay tak ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add prawns,mushrooms,mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Prawns aur mushrooms dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur 2-3 minutes kliya paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add black pepper powder,salt,chicken stock cube,vinegar,soy sauce,chilli sauce,oyster sauce and mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Kali mirch powder,namak,chicken stock cube,sirka,soy sauce,chilli sauce aur oyster sauce dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add chicken stock,mix well and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Yakhni dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ubal anay dein.
Gajar dal ker ache tarhan mix karein.

steps.instruction: In cornflour,add water and whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Cornflour mein pani dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add dissolve cornflour and cook until desired consistency & keep mixing in between.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka dissolve cornflour shamil karein aur desired consistency anay tak paka lein aur bech bech mein mix kertay rahein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add eggs white and whisk well until fluffy.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein anday ki safedi dal ker fluffy hunay tak ache tarhan whisk karein.
Thora thora ker ka shamil karein aur gently mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add green onion leaves & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: Hara pyaz dal ker mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with green onions leaves & serve hot!
steps.romanUrdu: Hara pyaz sa garnish ker ka garam serve karein!

ogDescription: Just the thing you should make in this cold weather. 19 B Soup recipe! If you don't have prawns then just replace with chicken. You will love the taste
